name: Wrath's Divinity
source:
A Distortion to meet in [i]A Case of Missing Identity.[/i] [b]Wrath's Divinity[/b] is a sadistic being who gains pleasure out of all suffering, whether from Tethers or Distortions. Formed from a man's sense of powerlessness against a soft-spoken evil that ruined his life, she believes herself to be better than God, and constantly seeks to pull more entities into her mirror in hopes of breaking free and reaching her full potential.

As a character, she always speaks in a light and airy tone, though it's very unsettling when she speaks of harrowing violence like one would the weather. She's constantly guiding Perdita to commit more and more atrocities, all in the guise of becoming strong enough to face her Tether when the time comes.
